violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily
violation_type.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim that the school age children play video games for more than an hour while in care.

finding_variants.text: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim that the school age children play video games for more than an hour while in care.
Based on the information gathered, it was found that children are watching television for more than one hour daily.
In the after schoolers room there were several students on their iPad's for more than hour upon inspection visit.
It was determined throughout the course of the HHS Investigation that children in care were allowed on their cell phones longer than 1 hour a day on occassion.
At time of inspection, children were observed watching television for over an hour.

During the inspection one child was observed using their personal Ipad throughout the inspection. Based on information gathered during the inspection the child is using the ipad for accommodations, that are not documented.
